title: Eligible fictional order
scenario_text: Eligible fictional order while the shortage flag is active.
expected_outcome: Display the approved MED-B alternative and current shortage guidance.

title: Contraindicated alternative

expected_outcome: Do not infer or display the alternative without a contraindication check.

title: Missing shortage condition
scenario_text: Fictional order without a supplied shortage-flag value.
expected_outcome: Flag the missing condition for review.
